items.title: George Wein interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: Bob Hope had “Thanks for the Memories,” all those tunes. I used to sing them all.

ctx.x: Wow that’s neat. And you say the pop songs of the day, these were things that would be like on the radio with vocal groups? © Fiillius Jazz Archive -2-

The tin pan alley songs of the 30s. All these, you know, Bob Hope had “Thanks for the Memories,” all those tunes. I used to sing them all. “Hold Me Honey, Won’t You Hold Me.” You don’t know any of those, because nobody knows those tunes.
But you could go out and buy the sheet music I suppose?
